what: header-only reachability census of the entire ModelLake
method: safetensors headers only -- 8-byte little-endian length then JSON of {dtype,shape,data_offsets}. Zero payload bytes read. Whole 4.29 TiB lake classified in 1.7s wall.

findings.claim: 43.5% of the lake by bytes is ALREADY QUANTIZED ON DISK
findings.evidence: Kimi-K3 1453.8 GiB U8 weight_packed + weight_scale; GLM-5.3-Flash 305.8 GiB F8_E4M3 + weight_scale_inv; DeepSeek-V4-Flash 148.7 GiB I8/F8_E4M3 + scale. Total 1908.3 GiB of 4386 GiB.
findings.consequence: G035's premise -- 'kimi_k3 alone at 1453.8 GiB = 15x machine RAM' framed as a compression target -- is wrong for these three. Those bytes are already a compressed representation, so a complete-EBPW figure computed against their on-disk byte count uses the wrong denominator. Their bf16 source-parameter equivalent must be recovered from config, not from du.

findings.claim: six distinct expert key schemes exist; the anatomy regex matched ONE
findings.evidence: A per-expert .{gate,up,down}_proj.weight | B stacked .gate_up_proj [512,1280,2560] | C stacked .w13_weight [256,4096,4096] | D per-expert .w1.weight I8+.scale | E per-expert .w1.weight_packed U8 | F per-expert _proj.weight F8_E4M3+weight_scale_inv
findings.consequence: 11 MoE-float bodies, of which only the scheme-A ones were reachable before.

findings.claim: expert layers do not start at 0 for 5 of 14 MoE bodies
findings.evidence: GLM-4.5-Air L1-46, Inkling-Small L2-41, LFM2-24B-A2B L2-39, GLM-5.3-Flash L3-45, Kimi-K3 L1-92
findings.consequence: a hardcoded layer=0 silently addresses a dense layer on those bodies

findings.claim: MY OWN CENSUS SHIPPED THE DEFECT IT WAS BUILT TO CATCH
findings.evidence: the first run used a NON-RECURSIVE glob and reported Wan2.2-T2V-A14B (117.5 GiB, 12 nested safetensors, 2190 tensors) and audio-flamingo-3 (16.7 GiB, 7 nested, 1222 tensors) as having no safetensors at all. Found by listing the directory rather than trusting the classification. 134.2 GiB reclassified.
findings.consequence: 2 of 9 NO-SAFETENSORS verdicts were false. The mutation that reverts recursive=True prints 'NO-SAFETENSORS' while its own blocked_by field lists '1x.safetensors' -- the check is now self-incriminating when broken.

findings.claim: the lake holds 4.472 TRILLION source parameters, 62% of them in one body
findings.evidence: Kimi-K3 accounts to 2779.9B source parameters at 4.492 complete EBPW; its bf16 parent would be 5.2 TiB, larger than the entire lake.
findings.consequence: Kimi-K3 is not an oversized obstacle. It is a published, capability-preserving sub-5-bit representation at trillion scale -- an existence proof sitting inside the search space the campaign is exploring, classified until now as unmeasurable.

findings.claim: bitnet-b1.58 has a COMPLETE EBPW of 3.908, not 1.58
findings.evidence: its packed body stores down_proj as [640,6912] where the bf16 twin is [2560,6912] -- four ternary values per byte, i.e. 2 bits each, not 1.58 -- and the embeddings stay bf16. 0.521B U8 + 0.329B BF16 = 1.179 GB over 2.413B parameters.
findings.consequence: the nominal-vs-complete gap is 2.47x on a model whose headline number IS its name. Exactly the denominator discipline the campaign applies to its own candidates, found in a published checkpoint.

findings.claim: MY CENSUS REPORTED 11.095 EBPW FOR THAT BODY AND THE TWIN-PAIR CONTROL CAUGHT IT
findings.evidence: the packed weights are named plainly '.weight' with no 'packed' marker and no num_bits in config, so the pack factor defaulted to 1 and the denominator was 4x too small. Two bodies of the same organism must report identical source parameters; they differed 0.850B vs 2.413B.
findings.consequence: the derivation was ALSO ambiguous where it appeared to work: Kimi-K3's 1792/112 = 16 is a standard block size, so pack=1 'confirmed' as readily as pack=2 gives 32. Only config.json (num_bits 4, group_size 32) settles it. The tool now requires two sources to agree and refuses otherwise.

complete_ebpw_accounting.method: stored bytes from safetensors headers (all tensors, scales included) divided by source-parameter count (scale/zero-point tensors EXCLUDED). Packing factor is never guessed: it comes from the model's own quantization_config and must AGREE with the scale tensors' group geometry, or the body is refused.
complete_ebpw_accounting.control: a bf16 body must account to exactly 16.000, and Qwen3-30B-A3B does. The twin-pair control is stronger: bitnet-b1.58-2B-4T ships packed and bf16, the same organism twice, so their source-parameter counts must be identical -- 2.413B both.
